answer: Attention Ledger Mechanism. Each identity must maintain a live response record on a random challenge schedule; missing three consecutive prompts moves it to a probationary ledge and voids its vote until repaired. A vertex in the reputation graph only counts once its record shows 30 days of unbroken replies. Every new identity also needs an established sponsor to carry its early challenge vine, and a sponsor can carry at most two. Persistent attention is the scarce input, so an attacker pays 30 days of real coverage per identity plus scarce sponsor slots; mass duplication stalls on both.
